name: New York

default_limits.basis: VTL 1180(b): 55 mph statewide unless a lower limit is set. NYC: 25 mph citywide unless posted (since Nov 7, 2014). Many villages/cities post area-wide limits at their borders.

fine.notes: Fine shown is the statutory max; the judge sets it. Minimums: $45 (1-10 over), $90 (11-30), $180 (31+). Max rises for repeat offenses within 18 months.

court_costs.notes: Surcharges: $55 (VTL 1809) + $5 crime victim fee + $28 (VTL 1809-e) = $88. Town/village courts add $5, so $93.

points.notes: Since 2/16/2026, points count for 24 months and 11+ points may suspend your license. 6+ points in 18 months triggers the Driver Responsibility Assessment.

zones.work_zone: Minimum fines doubled ($90-$600) and 8 points regardless of speed (since 2/16/2026).
zones.school_zone: School speed limits apply during posted times. Enhanced penalties apply.

court.reason: Fine up to $600, 8+ points, up to 30 days jail possible. At 41+ over: 11 points, so the license may be suspended.

arrest.offense: None by speed alone. Reckless driving (VTL 1212, misdemeanor) requires dangerous conduct, not just speed.

sources.title: NYC notice: DMV point rules eff. 2/16/2026 (11+ pts in 24 mo)

notes: Speeding is a traffic infraction, but jail is possible: up to 15 days at 11-30 over and 30 days at 31+ over (VTL 1180(h)(1)). nysenate.gov was unreachable, so statute text came from public.law. One version of VTL 1809 shows other surcharge amounts; verify $88/$93. The app should use 25 in NYC.
